d.ko: In a world bound by truths: connect. In Falsus is a mesmerizing rhythm game tied to an intricate card system brought together through a layered narrative. Taking place in a near-future world, traverse an atmospheric soundscape through the eyes of 5 interconnected protagonists.
d.en: In a world bound by truths: connect. In Falsus is a mesmerizing rhythm game tied to an intricate card system brought together through a layered narrative. Taking place in a near-future world, traverse an atmospheric soundscape through the eyes of 5 interconnected protagonists.
d.zh: 在被真实裹挟的世界里，「连接」。《In Falsus》将细致的卡牌系统与层层递进的剧情紧密结合，是一款魅力独特的节奏游戏。通过五位主角的不同视角体验相互交织的故事，享受深刻反映剧情的各式乐曲，纵身沉浸于近未来的鲜艳世界之中。
